_comment: Runtime egress allowlist, static layer. Every hostname written as an http(s) URL literal in shipped source must appear here under a group that states why. Enforced by egressAllowlist.vitest.ts. Classes: R required by the user's own configuration, O opt-in, D on by default or reachable without opting in (should shrink), X never contacted by shipped code, S link or text only.

groups.reason: Loopback: local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, MCP OAuth callbacks); never leaves the machine.
Reserved or invented example hosts in test corpora, evaluation cases and doc strings (RFC 2606 style); never contacted by code.
Hosts that appear only in the docs-crawl test cases (crawl-test-cases.ts); contacted only when a developer runs those opt-in network tests.
Strings in the reviewer evaluation corpus (auto/evaluation/cases.ts); sample commands the reviewer model judges, never executed against these hosts.
XML and schema namespace identifiers, never fetched.
Continuous's own documentation site on GitHub Pages: links shown to the user, and docs defaults; the user clicks.

Opt-in service the user configures with their own credentials: GitHub (docs crawler for github.com entries, git remotes), Greptile and Serper context providers, Discord, one consent-gated Chromium download from Google Cloud Storage.
Default API host of a model, embeddings or rerank provider; contacted only when the user adds that provider (or, for Ollama, when a local model list is requested).
Ollama's public model library (ollama.com/library), a plain GET with no key: only after the person chooses Download or Refresh in Ollama's setup; never at start-up or on a timer.

OpenRouter's public model list (openrouter.ai/api/v1/models), a plain GET with no key and a fixed user-agent: refreshed in the background when the local copy is older than modelCatalogRefreshHours (model information updates `automatic`, the default), and on Pull now, Refresh now or `continuous models refresh`. `modelCatalog: manual` stops the background refresh; `off` stops every request.

The community model catalogue (models.dev/api.json), a plain GET with no key and the same fixed user-agent: only while a selected model (the IDE's chat or reviewer model, the terminal agent's model) has no price from a price the person entered, a provider list or the curated tables. With model information updates `automatic` (the default) the background refresher fetches it when the local copy is missing or older than modelCatalogRefreshHours; with `manual` only on Refresh now in the IDE; `off` stops every request. Reachable without opting in, so class D.

The AWS Price List bulk file for Amazon Bedrock (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonBedrock/current/<region>/index.json), a public GET with no credentials and the same fixed user-agent as the OpenRouter list: only when a Bedrock model is configured, for the selected model's region. Under model information updates `automatic`, on selecting a Bedrock model and in the background when the local copy is older than modelCatalogRefreshHours; under `manual`, only on Bedrock Test connection; `off` stops every request.
Documentation, console, help and model-card links shown to the user in the settings UI, error messages and model metadata; opened only when the user clicks, never fetched by code.
